name: trace_decision
retrieval: keyword FTS in pinned current and explicitly opted-in prior meetings, plus matching pinned files
citation: Exact supporting quotations retain source ID/version/hash/time or original file lines. Model synthesis is separately labelled inference with IDs of validated quotations; structural validation is not semantic proof.
abstention: Absent rationale is unknown; private answers are never meeting evidence

termination.on_limit: further tool calls are denied; answer from evidence already retrieved or abstain

task_steps: Identify the decision and distinguish adopted, rejected and merely proposed options.
Separate explicitly stated reasons from your interpretation; say when rationale was not stated.
Connect a reason to its decision using supporting quotations; cite relevant retained code when present.
